hook: Krithivasan runs the largest IT services company in India and one of the largest in the world, and in September 2026 put its name on the largest AI data centre campus the country has announced: a 1 gigawatt, 250-acre, Rs 70,000 crore project in Hyderabad through the TCS subsidiary HyperVault. He reached the top of TCS after thirty-four years inside it, most of them running the banking, financial services and insurance business that is the company's biggest vertical. His stated programme as chief executive has been to build what TCS calls the world's largest AI-ready workforce, and the Hyderabad campus is the infrastructure side of that same claim.
name: K. Krithivasan

quote.text: His focus has been on two key pillars: customer centricity and employee empathy.

moniker: CEO and Managing Director, Tata Consultancy Services

secondary.name: TCS-HyperVault signs MoU with Telangana for Rs 70,000 crore AI data centre project, ANI via India Gazette, 5 September 2026

M.Tech industrial and management engineering, IIT Kanpur
timeline.impact: Management engineering before a career in IT services

timeline.event: Joins Tata Consultancy Services in July as an assistant system analyst in New Delhi

quick_facts: CEO and Managing Director of Tata Consultancy Services since June 2023
Thirty-seven years at TCS: joined July 1989 as an assistant system analyst in New Delhi, held delivery, customer, programme and sales roles to March 2007
President, Banking, Financial Services and Insurance, April 2007 to May 2023, based in Chennai; the company's largest industry vertical
Chairman of Tata Consultancy Services Japan and a director of TCS Foundation; co-chairs the B20 Digital Transformation Taskforce in Brazil

B.E. in mechanical engineering, Coimbatore Institute of Technology, 1981 to 1985 (degree of the University of Madras); M.Tech in industrial and management engineering, IIT Kanpur, 1986 to 1987; executive education at Harvard Business School

achievements.title: TCS HyperVault Hyderabad campus, 2026
achievements.impact: Led the TCS delegation that signed a memorandum of understanding with the Telangana government on 5 September 2026 for a 1 GW AI data centre campus on 250 acres, described by the state as India's largest, with a stated investment of Rs 70,000 crore.

achievements.title: Reorganised TCS by industry
achievements.impact: As CEO, realigned the company's structure into industry business groups, sharpening its focus on sectors rather than service lines.

achievements.title: AI-ready workforce
achievements.impact: Set and steered the strategy TCS describes as creating the world's largest AI-ready workforce.

achievements.title: BFSI vertical growth
achievements.impact: From 2018, led the banking, financial services and insurance unit to double-digit growth and steered its expansion into Latin America, Australia and New Zealand.
